deviations.derivation: The packet's scope decision 4 says the exhaustive-match ripple is confined to ssi.rs, ssi_trace.rs and ssi4.rs and is handled entirely inside write_allow. Measured against the tree this is false in both directions. (1) ssi4.rs contains ZERO SsiRefusal references (verified: no 'SsiRefusal' occurrence in src/construct/bie/ssi4.rs), so there are no arms to update there. (2) Two more exhaustive matches over SsiRefusal exist OUTSIDE write_allow: truck-certified/src/tangency/chart.rs:85-92 (TangencyRefusal::tag, inner `match cause` over all six variants, no catch-all) and truck-certified/src/tangency/a2.rs:544-553 (map_ssi, a full six-arm match with no wildcard). A compile probe that added the two packet-specified variants (TangentCurveSuspected { margin: (f64, f64) } and CoincidentPatchSuspected { margin: (f64, f64) }) to the enum at src/ssi.rs:97 produced E0004 non-exhaustive-pattern errors at exactly: src/ssi.rs:125 (tag, in write_allow), src/ssi_trace.rs:441 (map_ssi_refusal, in write_allow), src/tangency/chart.rs:85 (OUT of write_allow), src/tangency/a2.rs:545 (OUT of write_allow). The Done-when gates (`cargo test -p truck-certified --lib`, `cargo clippy -p truck-certified --all-targets -- -D warnings`) cannot pass without editing chart.rs and a2.rs, which are not in write_allow. Per the packet's own stop condition ('an exhaustive-match ripple reaches a file outside write_allow -> SPEC_GAP with the file named'), this is a stop, not a widening.

deviations.derivation: SsiRefusal derives `Eq` at src/ssi.rs:96. A variant payload of `(f64, f64)` cannot satisfy that derive (f64 is not Eq): the probe produced E0277 at src/ssi.rs:117. The natural fix -- dropping Eq from SsiRefusal -- cascades to two CONTAINING enums that derive Eq and hold SsiRefusal: TangencyRefusal (tangency/chart.rs:67, variant Ssi(SsiRefusal)) and SsiAdmitCause (ssi_admit.rs:61, variant Ssi(SsiRefusal)); both derive sites are OUTSIDE write_allow. Alternatively the payload evidence type must be redesigned to be Eq-compatible. Either way the packet must pre-decide the resolution; the literal variant shape as specified cannot land as written.
